plainLanguage: Kwa matumizi mengi ya kisheria, conviction iliyoishia kwa absolute au conditional discharge haitachukuliwa kama conviction, isipokuwa kwa proceedings zilizotajwa na section hii; lakini hali inaweza kubadilika ikiwa mtu wa conditional discharge baadaye anahukumiwa chini ya section 38A.
meaning: Section 38B limits the legal effect of a conviction followed by discharge under section 38. Subject to subsection (2), the conviction is deemed not to be a conviction except for the proceedings in which the order was made and later proceedings under section 38A. If a conditionally discharged person is later sentenced under section 38A, the protection ceases for that offence and the conviction is deemed to occur on the sentencing date.
keyPoints: Applies to convictions followed by absolute or conditional discharge under section 38.
Creates a statutory deeming rule limiting when that conviction counts as a conviction.
Preserves the proceedings in which discharge was ordered and proceedings under section 38A.
If later sentenced under section 38A, the special protection ceases for that offence.
Subsection (2) preserves appeal/same-offence protections and specified property consequences.

legalTerms.term: deemed not to be a conviction
legalTerms.meaning: Sheria inaagiza conviction hiyo isitazamwe kama conviction kwa madhumuni mengi, isipokuwa exceptions zilizowekwa.
Proceedings zinazofuata, hasa zile zinazoweza kuchukuliwa chini ya section 38A.

examples.title: Absolute discharge
examples.scenario: Mtu amepatikana na hatia lakini amepewa absolute discharge chini ya section 38.
examples.analysis: Section 38B inaweka special rule kuhusu madhumuni ambayo conviction hiyo itahesabika.

history.summary: Section 38B completes the discharge framework by defining the downstream legal status of a conviction followed by discharge.
notes: The exceptions in subsection (2) are important and should not be omitted when applying the deeming rule.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The section does not erase the historical fact of proceedings; it prescribes how the conviction is treated for legal purposes.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The appeal, same-offence and property-related exceptions in subsection (2) prevent an overbroad reading of subsection (1).

debateQuestion: Kwa purpose inayoulizwa, conviction iliyofuatiwa na discharge inahesabika au inaangukia kwenye deeming rule au exception ya section 38B?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
